datasheet.name: Might is Right
datasheet.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

datasheet.name: Dead Brutal
datasheet.text: While the Waaagh! is active for your army, this model’s ’uge choppa has a Damage characteristic of 3.

datasheet.name: Leader
datasheet.text: This model can be attached to the following unit: - Meganobz

datasheet.name: Speedboss
datasheet.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

datasheet.name: High-octane Fuel
datasheet.text: Each time this model’s unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in this model’s unit.

datasheet.name: Leader
datasheet.text: This model can be attached to the following units: - NOBZ ON WARBIKES - SKORCHAS - WARBIKERS - WARBUGGIES

datasheet.name: Channellin' da Waaagh!
datasheet.text: Each time this model attacks with a Psychic weapon, until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1 for every 5 models in this unit. While this unit contains 10 or more models, those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

datasheet.name: Leader
datasheet.text: This model can be attached to the following units: - Boyz - Nobz - Gretchin

datasheet.name: Indiscriminate Detonations
datasheet.text: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has resolved its attacks, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next Command phase. (While a unit is suppressed, it has ‑1 to hit rolls.)

datasheet.name: Blastajet Attack Run
datasheet.text: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit that cannot FLY, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

damaged.text: While this model has 1-4 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

datasheet.name: Fixit da Grot
datasheet.text: At the start of your Command phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

datasheet.name: Waaagh! Wazdakka
datasheet.text: If this model is your Warlord, Warbiker units from your army have the Battleline keyword.

datasheet.name: Throttlerokkit Shokka Engine
datasheet.text: In your Command phase, select one of the abilities in the Throttlerokkit Shokka Engine section. Until the start of your next Command phase, this model has that ability.

datasheet.name: Da Jump (Psychic)
datasheet.text: Once per turn, at the end of your Movement phase, one WEIRDBOY from your army can use this ability. If it does, roll one D6: on a 1, that WEIRDBOY’s unit suffers D6 mortal wounds; on a 2+, remove this WEIRDBOY’s unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy models.

datasheet.name: Waaagh! Energy
datasheet.text: While this model is leading a unit, add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of this model’s ’Eadbanger weapon for every 5 models in that unit (rounding down), but while that unit contains 10 or more models, that weapon has the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

datasheet.name: Leader
datasheet.text: This model can be attached to the following unit: - BOYZ - BREAKA BOYZ

datasheet.name: Roar of Mork (Psychic)
datasheet.text: In your opponent’s Command phase, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this Psyker and roll one D6: on a 1, this Psyker’s unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2+, until the start of your opponent’s next Command phase, that enemy unit is confrazzled. While a unit is confrazzled, each time a Battle-shock or Leadership test is taken for it, subtract 2 from that test.

datasheet.name: Unstable Oracle
datasheet.text: While this model is leading a unit, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this model’s Eyez of Mork weapon for every 5 models in that unit (rounding down), but while that unit contains 10 or more models, that weapon has the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

datasheet.name: Leader
datasheet.text: This model can be attached to the following unit: - Beast Snagga Boyz

datasheet.name: Super Runts
datasheet.text: While this model is leading a unit: - Models in that unit have the Scouts 9" ability. - Each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll. - Each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

datasheet.name: Special Dose
datasheet.text: While the Waaagh! is active for your army, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in this model’s unit.
